title: Your platform and Session Planner — Nottingham Forest F.C.
lead: Two tools come with coaching here. This one — the Forest game model, alongside masterclasses and on-the-grass sessions from some of the best coaches in the game. And Session Planner — where you build a session, animate it, and send it to your players before they reach the ground. You are already in the first. This module gets you set up on both.

item.q: What is the difference between “The 4 moments” and “Game Model: Reference”?
a:
• The 4 moments is the one you complete. It walks you through all four moments — In Possession, Transition to Defend, Out of Possession, Transition to Attack — and their pitch maps. Clips cannot be skipped, a pitch map only unlocks as complete once every clip on it has been watched, and the module is only finished when all seventy clips are done.
  • Game Model: Reference is the one you come back to. The same eight pitch maps, grouped into In Possession, Out of Possession and Transitions, with no locks and no order. Jump straight to the clip you want, skip through it, close it.
They track separately. Dipping into the reference maps will not move your progress on the learning module, and it will not show up in anyone’s report.
The way to think about it: complete The 4 moments once, then live in Reference week to week.
